title: REQ · Six palette-indexed item icon grids exist at 16x16
summary: Author six outlined, ramp-shaded 16x16 item icon grids as art sources
description: Context: game/frontend/src/art/sources.ts exports ART_SOURCES from BOY_SOURCES, ROOM_SOURCES and SCENE_EXTRA_SOURCES; grids use draw.ts helpers (createGrid, fillRect, outlineRect, shadeRect, rampIndex). Desired behavior: a new itemIcons module defines six 16x16 grids (old-key, note, book, coin, flashlight, photo) with an indigo outline and ramp shading, exported as ITEM_SOURCES with ids item/<name> and spread into ART_SOURCES. Why: the 3x2 inventory grid needs icons for six items.
acceptance_criteria: Given ITEM_SOURCES, When listed, Then it has six sources with unique ids item/old-key, item/note, item/book, item/coin, item/flashlight and item/photo.
Given each item source, When its frame is read, Then it is a single 16x16 grid containing the outline index and at least two ramp shades.
Given ART_SOURCES, When listed, Then it contains all six item sources.

out_of_scope: Changing game state or content item definitions
preserve: Existing source ids and ordering of earlier sources

technical_constraints: Grids are pure functions built from draw.ts helpers using indices from the shared palette.
Constraint: one shared palette of at most 48 colours.
definition_of_done: itemIcons module and ART_SOURCES wiring exist and type-check.
